objective: Run the already-frozen HAR-RSV volatility/risk-state confirmation on genuine OSE Nikkei 225 Mini 5-minute history derived locally from personally licensed 225Labo annual files, without changing the proxy-era model specification or promotion threshold.

source.raw_frequency: source-provided 5-minute primary; source-provided 1-minute measurement QA only
source.cloud_input: non-reconstructive daily RV/RSV derived panel only

data_integrity.source_date_semantics: 225Labo date label treated as OSE trading date after direct schema/order verification

models.challenger: HAR_RSV: logRV_t ~ 1 + logRSV+_{t-1} + logRSV-_{t-1} + weekly_logRV + monthly_logRV

stability_gate.rationale: Use a predeclared post-J-GATE3.0 recent regime rather than selecting a favorable interval after results.
stability_gate.requirement: QLIKE and MSE improvement directions in the recent period must each be non-negative.

stage_a_pass_rule: HAR_RSV full-OOS mean QLIKE loss is lower than HAR_RV
HAR_RSV full-OOS mean MSE loss is lower than HAR_RV
Recent-period QLIKE and MSE improvements are each non-negative
At least one of QLIKE or MSE 5-day block-bootstrap probabilities of positive improvement is >= 0.95
Derived manifest has zero unresolved critical data-quality issues

interpretation.pass: TRUE_OSE_MINI_STAGE_A_PASS; proceed to exact-product JNU Micro Stage B without retuning.
interpretation.fail: TRUE_OSE_MINI_STAGE_A_FAIL; a short Micro result cannot rescue the family.

forbidden: Change bootstrap block length/sample count/seed after outcome inspection
Select a favorable subperiod after outcome inspection
Use 1-minute QA to choose a different primary estimator
Add leverage/jumps/neural features to rescue a negative Stage A result
Treat Stage A alone as final JNU validation without Micro Stage B
